prompt: Remy arrives and learns that no River box is for sale yet. What should Remy do?
promptZh: Remy 抵達後得知目前沒有 River 箱可買。接下來應怎麼做？

options.text: Ask to take an uncollected River reservation in exchange for the Hill box.
options.zh: 要求用 Hill 箱交換一箱還未被領取的 River 預訂箱。
options.whyZh: 指南禁止用尚未領取的預訂箱作交換，Noa 也明說不要交換。

options.text: Wait to show the code until the volunteers can provide both boxes.
options.zh: 等志工可以同時提供兩箱時，再出示代碼。
options.whyZh: Noa 要求 River 沒得買時先領預訂的 Hill，不需要兩箱同時取。

options.text: Show KITE-24 for the Hill box and ask when to check again for a River box.
options.zh: 出示 KITE-24 領取 Hill 箱，再詢問何時能回來看看有沒有 River 箱。
options.whyZh: 入口須以代碼領取；留言提供 KITE-24、保留 Hill 的指示和 River 無貨時的下一步。

options.text: Use KITE-24 to claim a River box when one is released.
options.zh: 等有釋出的 River 箱，用 KITE-24 去領那一箱。
options.whyZh: KITE-24 屬於 Noa 的 Hill 預訂，釋出的 River 箱是另售，不是用該代碼改領。

explanationZh: 入口須以代碼領取；留言提供 KITE-24、保留 Hill 的指示和 River 無貨時的下一步。
evidence: show your collection code at the entrance desk. / The code on my receipt is KITE-24. / If they say there are no River boxes for sale yet, please just collect mine, then ask the entrance volunteer when to check again.

vocabulary.note: 不需先有預訂，到場若有貨即可購買。
